findings.finding: The photographic place begins 268.75 pixels below the top edge and occupies only 972.7 pixels of a 1600-pixel desktop width.
findings.mechanism: Administrative framing precedes and competes with the place that is supposed to establish the object.

findings.finding: The use loop, operating seat, registered zone, evidence state, and household stop state are exposed as simultaneous top-level ontologies.
findings.mechanism: A first-time household user must decode the system before acting on the living object.

findings.finding: The photograph is treated as a framed evidence panel inside an interface rather than as the operating landscape from which controls emerge.
findings.mechanism: Persistent surrounding chrome makes the image one component among many instead of the retained place that carries the use loop.

findings.finding: Registration geometry remains persistently visible as instrumentation instead of becoming a low-weight, landscape-following interaction layer.
findings.mechanism: Persistent hotspot affordances improve testability but make the image read as an annotated diagram.

findings.finding: Passing mobile reflow and 200-percent text tests proves containment rather than semantic priority.
findings.mechanism: The same control inventory can stack without overflow while still becoming a long administrative wall.

findings.finding: Evidence and authority vocabulary is too prominent for first-use comprehension.
findings.mechanism: The first layer should answer what the object is, where it belongs, what it needs today, and what the household can do next.

disposition.preserve_current_surface_as: instrumented review harness and behavioral donor

next_object_acceptance_floor: The photographic place begins no more than 64 CSS pixels below the viewport top on desktop.
The photographic place occupies at least 70 percent of the first desktop viewport area and at least 55 percent of the first mobile viewport height.
No more than three persistent interactive controls appear over or beside the place before the first user action.
Only one active loop action, one compact seat summary, and one household stop affordance remain continuously visible.
Mode, seat, evidence, and authority inventories open contextually rather than competing as simultaneous top-level navigation.
Registration geometry is hidden until interaction and follows natural image borders where the donor permits.
No overlay may cover more than 25 percent of the rendered photograph at one time.
All 61 source checks and all 73 behavioral checks remain satisfied or are replaced by stricter equivalents.
The successor campaign retains desktop, 390-pixel mobile, 200-percent text, keyboard, URL-state, zero-external-request, zero-console-error, and no-embedded-acceptance evidence.

evidence_ledger.evidence_tier: retained browser screenshots, measured rendered geometry, and source-linked workflow receipts
evidence_ledger.target: visual hierarchy of the bounded review object
evidence_ledger.upside: preserve verified behavior while restoring place-first comprehension
evidence_ledger.downside: a cosmetic rewrite could obscure authority or regress accessibility
evidence_ledger.failure_mode: retain the current harness, keep acceptance absent, and refuse merge or release

control_question: Can the next composition make the household understand the living object from the place itself before exposing the machinery that proves the system is governed?
